title: Health-to-Productivity Tradeoff Days
dataSources: Cross-stream correlations (`correlation:pair`), anomaly-day rollups (`anomalyday:score`), personal SLA checks (`personalsla:status`), and daily life scores (`lifescore:daily`).
app: Meta-monitoring for every `index=personal` stream, turning cross-signal correlations, anomaly-day scoring, and personal SLA dashboards into Splunk-native analytics.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=anomalyday:score
| search tradeoff_score=*
| stats count as days avg(tradeoff_score) as avg_tradeoff_score by tradeoff_type
| sort 0 - days
description: Ranks tradeoff typess by health-to-productivity tradeoff days.
value: Tradeoff days are where high output may be borrowing from recovery in a way that is not sustainable.
implementation: Send health-to-productivity tradeoff days events to `index=personal` and keep `tradeoff_type` populated so the leaderboard stays actionable.
visualization: Bar chart of health-to-productivity tradeoff days by tradeoff types.
grandmaExplanation: It lists which tradeoff typess stand out most for health-to-productivity tradeoff days.
